name: Working Holiday visa (subclass 417)
summary: A working holiday for young adults from partner countries. Work is optional and usually limited to 6 months with one employer, and study is limited to 4 months. Australia has 19 subclass 417 arrangements. Cyprus, Finland, Germany, South Korea and the UK use ages 18 to 35. UK passport holders can get up to three 12-month visas.

other: Only passports from partner countries qualify. We could not read the full country list or age limits for every country.
Age 18 to 35 is confirmed only for Cyprus, Finland, Germany, South Korea and the UK.

stay.note: 12 months per visa. UK passport holders can have three, up to 3 years total. Other countries may need specified work for later visas.

name: Student visa (subclass 500)
summary: For full-time study at a recognized institution. Rules have tightened, with a genuine student test, higher English and financial requirements, and no more uncapped work hours. other: Onshore exceptions include PhD students, school students, needing up to 12 more months with the same provider, and DFAT or Defence sponsorship.
Family exceptions include PhD students, DFAT or Defence sponsored students, foreign government scholarships, and eligible students from Pacific or ASEAN countries.

name: Citizenship by conferral (PR to citizenship)
summary: The main route to citizenship. You must have lived in Australia on a valid visa for the 4 years before applying, including the last 12 months as a permanent resident (or a Special Category 444 holder). You can be absent no more than 12 months in the 4 years and no more than 90 days in the last 12 months. You also sit the citizenship test, in English, based on Our Common Bond, then attend an interview and a ceremony with a pledge.

eligibility.language: Citizenship test is in English only
other: Exemptions and discretions may apply.
Fee amounts are in form 1298i, which we did not read.
Dual citizenship: the application asks about other citizenships, but we did not find an official page stating the rule. Check before relying on this.

citizenship.note: 4 years lawful residence, with 12 months as a permanent resident.
